macros.name: jacobi
macros.doc: Two commands (with identical results) \legendre and \jacobi are defined to typeset Legendre symbols and Jacobi symbols.

macros.name: legendre
macros.doc: Two commands (with identical results) \legendre and \jacobi are defined to typeset Legendre symbols and Jacobi symbols.

macros.name: restr
macros.doc: \restr for denoting restritions of functions to subsets of their domain.

macros.name: set
macros.doc: A general macro for denoting sets is \set which automatically places scalable braces around the argument.

macros.name: where
macros.doc: A scalable version of \mid, called \where, is also included.

envs.name: augmentedmatrix
envs.doc: The environment augmentedmatrix takes two arguments n and m and makes a matrix of n+m columns with a vertical rule after the n-th column, allowing the typesetting of systems with (multiple) right hand sides in matrix form.
